Medical Record Disclosure Policy

1.Policy & procedure for Disclosure of medical records

1.0 POLICY:

Patient’s medical records data and information shall be disclosure as per hospital policy.

2.0 PURPOSE:

All medical records will be disclosure as per laid down procedure.

3.0 DEFINITION (IF ANY):

Nil

4.0 ABBREVIATIONS (IF ANY):

Nil

5.0 SCOPE:

Hospital wide

6.0 RESPONSIBILITY:

Medical Record Personnel.

7.0 DISTRIBUTION:

Medical Record Department.

  • PROCESS DETAILS:
  • Process to disclosure patient record
  • Who has Access to Medical Records?
  • Medical records are the property of the hospital. It is a confidential communication of the patient and cannot be disclosure without his permission
  • All patients have right to access their records and obtain copy of those records
  • Patient’s legal representative has the right to those records as long as patient has signed a disclosure of records to accompany any request from the legal representative
  • Other health care providers have the right to the records of the patient, if they are directly involved in the care and treatment of the patient
  • Parents of a minor also have access to patient’s medical records
  • Medical records summoned in a court of law in cases like-road traffic accident, medical negligence, insurance claim etc.
  • Disclosure of Records
  • Request for medical records by patient or authorized attendant should be in the format given below & acknowledged. and documents should be issued within 72 h
  • As per application Medical record file of the patient called from MRD Department.
  • MRD Department incharge after receiving application copy take out MR file from MRD cabinet & enter file details in Case file Record Register.
  • MRD Department incharge will Xerox the file & make receipt with rate of RS. 2/- per page. & will keep it back to cabinet with entry in Case file Record Register.
  • After confirmation from administrator copy will be handed over to patient with acknowledgement indicating No. of pages.
